verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents its own alerting: alerts on log patterns, counts or attribute values, alerts seeded from any dashboard panel, and a general promise of signal monitoring with timely notifications. That covers the core of alerting across telemetry signals. However, the pack contains no evidence of notification routing, grouping, or silencing, which are a major part of the story. missing for 10: documented notification routing (channels/policies), alert grouping, silencing/muting of notifications, explicit alerting on traces and metrics, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can alert on any telemetry signal with routing, grouping, and silencing of notifications

citations.quote: Set up alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values.
create an alert seeded from the panel
Monitor signals and receive timely notifications
